Wilderness '''zombies''' are a form of undead found in the [[Graveyard of Shadows]]. They attack with [[melee]] and have a low resistance to magical attacks, particularly [[fire spells]].

Only level 29 zombies (the ones wearing a helm) have secondary drops.

==Champion's Challenge==
Zombies are one of the 'races' who have a lesser champion in the [[Champion's Challenge]] [[Distraction and Diversion]]. To fight the [[Zombie Champion]], the player must kill zombies until one drops a [[Zombie Champion's scroll|champion's scroll]], a 1/5000 drop.

While [[undead one]]s count towards a zombie slayer task, they do not drop champions' scrolls.

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Magic ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=patch|update=MHAW & Double XP - This Week In RuneScape|date=15 May 2023}}
** Updated models for skeletons, zombies and giant rats within the Wilderness, giving them the new [[Unwelcome Guests]] models.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Unwelcome Guests Slayer Content - This Week In RuneScape|date=11 April 2023}}
** Zombies can be killed as part of the new undead slayer task.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (9 November 2009)|date=9 November 2009}}
** Reworked various zombie and [[skeleton]] combat animations.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (25 March 2009)|date=25 March 2009}}
** Stopped a zombie from playing a human animation that made it appear to explode briefly. Zombies in RuneScape have enough to worry about without an irrational fear of spontaneous combustion.

* {{UL|type=update|update=The Lair of Tarn Razorlor|date=22 January 2007}}
** Zombies, skeletons and ghosts have been graphically updated.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Runescape beta is now online!|date=4 January 2001}}
** Added to game.
}}

==Trivia==
* An update on [[12 April]] [[2010]] made the sound of the zombies when they get hit much deeper than previously.
* Zombies drop fishing bait commonly. It is revealed in [[Let Them Eat Pie]] and [[Recipe for Disaster]] that fishing bait is actually maggots, which are often found on corpses.
